subject: Cohort convertibility incentive pilot — packaging & invoicing options
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@vertexfoundry.co>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — conversion incentive for July cohort

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders were excited by the latency/cost profile and the console traces. We run a 12-week summer cohort and are piloting two partner credits this cycle. Quick ask: would Redwood consider a small, metric-linked top-up (extra $3k in credits) if at least 20% of cohort startups convert to a paid plan within 90 days?

We think this is lower-risk for Redwood than an up-front larger credit and aligns incentives. If you can do this, we also need clarity on how credits are invoiced and whether we can push a single SOW to our finance team that covers pilot terms + conversion discount (so it's one signing package). Attached a one-page pilot outline.

Would love a short call tomorrow to sketch options — CC'ing our ops contact.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Program Director, VertexFoundry Accelerator
[Attachment: Vertex_Pilot_SOW_draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@vertexfoundry.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 18:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — conversion incentive for July cohort

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear framing and for sharing the outline. Short answer: we like the metric-linked approach and it sounds feasible. A few things to confirm on our side before we commit:

- Definition of "convert": would this be any paid plan activation or require a minimum monthly commitment?
- Timing: can we align the 90-day window to our billing cutoffs so recognition of the top-up is straightforward?
- Legal/finance: we will need an SOW and a brief amendment for how credits are applied and reclaimed if conversion criteria aren't met.

Ben (partners ops) and Marissa (partnerships) are looped in — Ben, can you flag any constraints from a Dedicated capacity or credit-phasing standpoint? Marissa, are there precedent promo terms we can reuse?

Happy to do a 20-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for you.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — conversion incentive for July cohort

Soojin / Aisha —

Quick notes from ops:
- Extra credits are easy to attach as a promo SKU; we can gate the credit disbursement on HubSpot deal stage + invoice flag.
- "Convert" should be defined as activating any paid plan AND the account consuming >$200/mo in month 1 post-conversion (avoids one-off $1 tests).
- We prefer a single SOW that spells out the redemption path and the conditions for clawback. That keeps finance happy.
- If Vertex requests invoice deferral (and I know some accelerators prefer consolidated billing), we can do a two-invoice pattern: an initial pilot admin invoice (nominal) then the conversion credit applied as a contra if conditions met.

I'll draft the technical flow + accounting stub and drop into the Drive link by EOD.

Ben
Director, Partner Operations

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@vertexfoundry.co>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — conversion incentive for July cohort

Aisha —

We have run a few similar partner pilots. Suggested packaging that has moved fast:

1) Pilot package: $6k in up-front credits + additional $3k contingent credit on 20%+ cohort conversion within 90 days.
2) Public promo: 10% discount for direct conversions within 30 days (not part of the contingent credit).
3) Credit expiry: pilot credits expire 180 days from issue; contingent credits issue within 30 days of verified conversion metric and appear as negative invoice line.

I'll attach a slim promo terms PDF for your counsel to review. If Vertex is okay with the 20% threshold and the $200/mo minimum Ben called out, we can prepare the SOW and a short addendum for conversion accounting.

Marissa
Sr. Partnerships Manager
[Attachment: Promo_Terms_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@vertexfoundry.co>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — conversion incentive for July cohort

Thanks, all — this is very helpful. Vertex is comfortable with the $200/mo minimum and the 20% threshold. A couple of asks from finance on our side:

- Can the contingent credit be paid out as a credit note on the Vertex account (rather than a literal refund)? That makes reconciliation straightforward for us.
- Can you include a clause in the SOW that allows Vertex to share anonymized conversion metrics with Redwood for joint case studies?

If you can send a redline of the SOW that includes those points, we can aim to sign by next Wednesday. We'll plan for the call on Friday at 10am PT to finalize.

Best,
Aisha
